page.overview:
What is Almraiven?

Almraiven was one of the great cities of the nation of Calimshan. It was most notable for being the nation's first and premier center for magical studies, until the late 15 century DR, when the region's enslaved populace rose up and overthrew their tyrannical genie-kin rulers.

Almraiven was on the south-western shores of Calimshan, a port of the Shining Sea. It was close to the Spider Swamp and Alimir Mountains.

Almraiven was built using the "drudach system", This Calishite form of urban structuring, established all the way back to when the land was ruled by genies, consisted of an interlocking series of small brick-walled neighborhoods called drudachs. All drudachs were further grouped together into subdivisons known as sabbans, whose boundaries were similarly marked by low mud-brick walls. Each sabban worked as a self-sufficient town—it had its own water supplies, guards, markets, residences, and so on. The city had a total of 12 sabbans and 49 drudachs.

The largest of these sabbans was the Mage's Quarter. Located in the center of the city, it was comprised of seven drudachs.
